UPDATE containers SET
            name = coalesce($2, name),
            kind = coalesce($3, kind),
            notes = coalesce($4, notes),
            archived_at = CASE
                WHEN $5::boolean IS NULL THEN archived_at
                WHEN $5 THEN coalesce(archived_at, $6)
                ELSE NULL
            END
        WHERE id = $1
